Next Opinion · Município de Caldas da Rainha 1
Business location areas and the PDM
The municipal survey reports approximately 400 ha of industrial land in the current PDM across eight areas,  
and 586 ha in the proposed revision, an increase of approximately 186 ha (+46%). Cidade and Tornada  
concentrate most activity. Cidade records around 120 companies and is approximately one minute from the  
A8 junction; Tornada is around two minutes from the N8 junction.
Area Current PDM (ha) Proposed PDM (ha) Change
Cidade 155.7 304.9 +96%
Tornada 85.6 147.5 +72%
São Gregório I + II 11.2 61.4 ≈+450%
Santa Cecília 25.7 28.5 +11%
Santa Catarina 18.7 24.1 +29%
Casal do Rei 39.4 10.2 −74%
Lagoa Parceira 24.3 — removed
Vale do Carvalhal 39.4* — removed
Zambujeiro — 5.0 new
Mouraria — 4.3 new
Reported total 400.1 586.0 ≈+46%
PDM areas are planning designations, not plots available for sale or lease. Reported totals (400.1 and 586.0 ha) differ by 0.1 ha from the sum 
of the rounded rows. The 39.4 ha for Vale do Carvalhal remain unconfirmed in the municipal source.
Availability reported in the survey: Santa Cecília 21.5 ha (24% occupied), São Gregório 17.1 ha (22%) and Santa Catarina  
13.3 ha (45%). Occupancy and availability boundaries have not been reconciled with the PDM boundaries; in São Gregório,  
17.1 ha exceeds the 11.2 ha in the current PDM. Confirm the polygons, reference date, ownership and marketable plots with  
the Municipality.
Planning  indices:  Notice  No.  9386/2023  distinguishes  maximum  building  coverage  of  0.75  from  maximum  impervious  surface  
coverage of 0.85. This does not mean 85% building coverage. Confirm the rules applicable to each plot with municipal planning  
services. Source: https://files.dre.pt/2s/2023/05/092000000/0026600267.pdf
Source: Municipality of Caldas da Rainha, industrial land survey supplied for this revision on 19 October 2026. The proposed PDM revision  
remains subject to approval.
